verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَيُّوبَ فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
verses.web: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,
verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת־אִיֹּ֗וב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «هَلْ يُخَاصِمُ ٱلْقَدِيرَ مُوَبِّخُهُ، أَمِ ٱلْمُحَاجُّ ٱللهَ يُجَاوِبُهُ؟».
verses.kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct [him]? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
verses.he: הֲ֭רֹב עִם־שַׁדַּ֣י יִסֹּ֑ור מֹוכִ֖יחַ אֱלֹ֣והַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃ פ

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ ٱلرَّبَّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: ¶ Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered Yahweh,
verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיֹּ֥וב אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «هَا أَنَا حَقِيرٌ، فَمَاذَا أُجَاوِبُكَ؟ وَضَعْتُ يَدِي عَلَى فَمِي.
verses.kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.web: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.he: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמֹו־פִֽי׃

verses.ar: مَرَّةً تَكَلَّمْتُ فَلَا أُجِيبُ، وَمَرَّتَيْنِ فَلَا أَزِيدُ».
verses.kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
verses.he: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אֹוסִֽיף׃ פ

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَيُّوبَ مِنَ ٱلْعَاصِفَةِ فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: ¶ Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:
verses.he: וַיַּֽעַן־יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יֹּוב *מִנ *סְעָרָה (מִ֥ן ׀ סְעָרָ֗ה) וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «ٱلْآنَ شُدَّ حَقْوَيْكَ كَرَجُلٍ. أَسْأَلُكَ فَتُعْلِمُنِي.
verses.kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
verses.he: אֱזָר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהֹודִיעֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ تُنَاقِضُ حُكْمِي، تَسْتَذْنِبُنِي لِكَيْ تَتَبَرَّرَ أَنْتَ؟
verses.kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
verses.he: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃

verses.ar: هَلْ لَكَ ذِرَاعٌ كَمَا لِلهِ، وَبِصَوْتٍ مِثْلِ صَوْتِهِ تُرْعِدُ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
verses.he: וְאִם־זְרֹ֖ועַ כָּאֵ֥ל ׀ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְקֹ֗ול כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃

verses.ar: تَزَيَّنِ ٱلْآنَ بِٱلْجَلَالِ وَٱلْعِزِّ، وَٱلْبَسِ ٱلْمَجْدَ وَٱلْبَهَاءَ.
verses.kjv: Deck thyself now [with] majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
verses.he: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽאֹ֣ון וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְהֹ֖וד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: فَرِّقْ فَيْضَ غَضَبِكَ، وَٱنْظُرْ كُلَّ مُتَعَظِّمٍ وَٱخْفِضْهُ.
verses.kjv: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one [that is] proud, and abase him.
verses.web: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
verses.he: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְרֹ֣ות אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى كُلِّ مُتَعَظِّمٍ وَذَلِّلْهُ، وَدُسِ ٱلْأَشْرَارَ فِي مَكَانِهِمِ.
verses.kjv: Look on every one [that is] proud, [and] bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.web: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
verses.he: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱطْمِرْهُمْ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ مَعًا، وَٱحْبِسْ وُجُوهَهُمْ فِي ٱلظَّلَامِ.
verses.kjv: Hide them in the dust together; [and] bind their faces in secret.
verses.web: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.he: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃

verses.ar: فَأَنَا أَيْضًا أَحْمَدُكَ لِأَنَّ يَمِينَكَ تُخَلِّصُكَ.
verses.kjv: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.web: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.he: וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י אֹודֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־תֹושִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا بَهِيمُوثُ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعْتُهُ مَعَكَ يَأْكُلُ ٱلْعُشْبَ مِثْلَ ٱلْبَقَرِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.web: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמֹות אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃

verses.ar: هَا هِيَ قُوَّتُهُ فِي مَتْنَيْهِ، وَشِدَّتُهُ فِي عَضَلِ بَطْنِهِ.
verses.kjv: Lo now, his strength [is] in his loins, and his force [is] in the navel of his belly.
verses.web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א כֹחֹ֣ו בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנֹ֗ו בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يَخْفِضُ ذَنَبَهُ كَأَرْزَةٍ. عُرُوقُ فَخِذَيْهِ مَضْفُورَةٌ.
verses.kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.he: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָבֹ֣ו כְמֹו־אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י *פַחֲדֹו (פַחֲדָ֣יו) יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃

verses.ar: عِظَامُهُ أَنَابِيبُ نُحَاسٍ، جِرْمُهَا حَدِيدٌ مَمْطُولٌ.
verses.kjv: His bones [are as] strong pieces of brass; his bones [are] like bars of iron.
verses.web: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.he: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃

verses.ar: هُوَ أَوَّلُ أَعْمَالِ ٱللهِ. ٱلَّذِي صَنَعَهُ أَعْطَاهُ سَيْفَهُ.
verses.kjv: He [is] the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach [unto him].
verses.web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
verses.he: ה֖וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשֹׂו יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْجِبَالَ تُخْرِجُ لَهُ مَرْعًى، وَجَمِيعَ وُحُوشِ ٱلْبَرِّ تَلْعَبُ هُنَاكَ.
verses.kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
verses.he: כִּֽי־ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־לֹ֑ו וְֽכָל־חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־שָֽׁם׃

verses.ar: تَحْتَ ٱلسِّدْرَاتِ يَضْطَجِعُ فِي سِتْرِ ٱلْقَصَبِ وَٱلْغَمِقَةِ.
verses.kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
verses.he: תַּֽחַת־צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃

verses.ar: تُظَلِّلُهُ ٱلسِّدْرَاتُ بِظِلِّهَا. يُحِيطُ بِهِ صَفْصَافُ ٱلسَّوَاقِي.
verses.kjv: The shady trees cover him [with] their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.web: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
verses.he: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲלֹ֑ו יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָֽחַל׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱلنَّهْرُ يَفِيضُ فَلَا يَفِرُّ هُوَ. يَطْمَئِنُّ وَلَوِ ٱنْدَفَقَ ٱلْأُرْدُنُّ فِي فَمِهِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, [and] hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפֹּ֑וז יִבְטַ֓ח ׀ כִּֽי־יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־פִּֽיהוּ׃

verses.ar: هَلْ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَمَامِهِ؟ هَلْ يُثْقَبُ أَنْفُهُ بِخِزَامَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: He taketh it with his eyes: [his] nose pierceth through snares.
verses.web: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.he: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֹֽוקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב־אָֽף׃
